description: This file defines API routes for user authentication and profile management in a FastAPI application, including signup, login, profile retrieval, and profile updating functionalities.

methods.name: signup(user_data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new user account with provided user data.

methods.name: login( form_data: Annotated[OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, Depends()], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user credentials and issue an access token.

methods.name: read_users_me( current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)] )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the current user profile.

methods.name: update_user_me( user_update: UserUpdate, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to update current user's profile information.

ctags.name: login
ctags.signature: ( form_data: Annotated[OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, Depends()], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^async def signup(user_data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):$/

ctags.name: update_user_me
ctags.signature: ( user_update: UserUpdate, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
